answer: Approve the vendor only with conditions: it met [F4] of controls against the [F8] our policy requires, and the gaps include encryption of stored data for [F1] customer records.
exec_summary: The vendor would handle [F1] customer records.
It fully met [F3] of [F2] controls, [F4], short of policy by [F9].
It did not meet [F6] controls, including encryption and a tested recovery plan.
Its hosting subcontractor has not been assessed.
situation: A business planning to outsource customer support to a vendor.
complication: The vendor falls short of the policy for critical vendors and relies on an unassessed subcontractor.
key_question: Should the business sign with the vendor, and on what conditions?

titles.situation: The vendor falls short of our policy.
titles.options: Two ways to proceed with the vendor.
titles.recommendation: Approve only with conditions met before go-live.
titles.roadmap: Agree conditions, verify them, then go live.
titles.kpis: Two measures show the vendor meets policy.
titles.risks: The main risk is customer data exposed at the vendor.

hypotheses.text: The vendor can close the gaps before go-live.

issue_tree.so_what: The committee should not approve without conditions.

issue_tree.finding: The gaps touch the data the vendor would hold.

hypotheses.text: Customer data would be exposed in a breach at the vendor.

issue_tree.so_what: Encryption and recovery must be fixed before data moves.

options.name: Conditional approval
options.description: Sign only if encryption, a tested recovery plan and a subcontractor review come first.

options.name: Find another vendor
options.description: Restart selection with vendors that meet policy today.

recommendation.rationale: It closes the gaps that expose [F1] customer records while keeping the outsourcing plan; the vendor risk committee decides.

actions: Agree conditions with the vendor and put them to the committee in three weeks.
Verify encryption, the recovery test and the subcontractor review.
Confirm the vendor meets policy before any data moves.

risks.mitigation: Make each condition a requirement before any data moves.
Require the vendor to move hosting or end the deal.

rows.action: Make encryption a condition before any data moves.
Require a recovery test with results before go-live.
Send our questionnaire to the subcontractor through the vendor.
Agree a remediation date for each with the vendor.
